_README: THE ONE PLACE TO CHANGE THE REPOSITORY AND BRANCH.
deploy/setup.ps1 reads this file, so switching the office from the
demo repo to the live one is an edit to the two lines below - not a
code change, and not a flag anybody has to remember to type.
Edit it in the ROLLOUT KIT (the folder holding SETUP.bat, setup.ps1
and MT5-golden.zip). That copy is what new PCs are built from.
A machine already installed does not re-read this: it has a git
remote of its own. To move an existing PC to a different repo, run
in C:\MT5-Trader, or just delete C:\MT5-Trader and run SETUP.bat
again - the trader's config.json and .env are NOT in the repo, so
reinstalling does not lose the accounts.
-Token on the SETUP.bat command line still wins over anything here;
the token is deliberately not storable in this file, because this
file travels on a USB stick.
_python: The interpreters this project has actually been run on, green.
3.11 on Linux and Windows; 3.14 on a Windows office PC (625 passed).
A LIST because refusing a machine that already has a proven version
would mean installing a second Python on every desk for nothing.
Anything not listed here is refused loudly rather than used, so a
stray 3.9 cannot quietly become the one PC that behaves differently.
Add a version here only once the whole suite has passed on it.
MetaTrader5's IPC handshake fails on a 32-bit Python with an error
that says nothing, so the bitness is checked and refused too - and
that check is not negotiable whatever this list says.
